title: Guest session engine: join, send, render remote transcript
goal: A guest client can join a live command post over any transport (LAN or relay), submit queue items, and keep a correct, decrypted, ordered local copy of the remote transcript, queue and roster, even across reconnects.
scope_in: GuestSession engine in packages/session/src/guest/ driving the Transport interface (C074) for join, hello/welcome, resume and reconnect, using the session client (C057), queue client (C058), reliable delivery (C055) and crypto (C056) as building blocks.

Pure reducer `reduceGuestState(state, frame)` that folds sequenced frames (message.user, message.assistant.delta/done, message.system, tool.request, tool.result, approval.request/decision, agent.spawn/state/exit, queue.*, control.*) into an immutable GuestState that TUI and web render.
Guest-side queue behaviour: submit (que_ ULID as frame id, hybrid `p {item,size,kind}` + `ct {body}`), cancel own item while queued/approved, track position and state from queue.state.
The `waiting_for_key` state: ciphertext received before a key.grant arrives is buffered (bounded) and decrypted once the grant is opened.
Role-aware gating that mirrors CT-RBAC for UI only (viewer cannot submit; muted member sees a read-only composer); the server remains the authority.
scope_out: Host-side queue, approvals, broadcast and history (C075).
Transport implementations and the Transport interface itself (C072, C074); relay handshake and heartbeat (C054).
Rendering widgets: TUI transcript (C036) and web transcript (C083) consume GuestState but are not built here.
Handoff / pair mode (C079) and reactions/comments UI (C080).
build_against: Run against the mock backend (lane C007) relay simulator, scripted with contracts/fixtures/events/*.json frames, and against an in-memory loopback Transport pair wired to the C075 host engine. No real relay or LAN host needed.
interfaces: class GuestSession { static join(opts: {transport: Transport; ticket: () => Promise<string>; keys: KeyStore; clock: Clock; ids: IdGen}): Promise<GuestSession>; readonly state$: Observable<GuestState>; submit(body: string, kind?: 'message'|'command'): Promise<QueueItemId>; cancel(item: QueueItemId): Promise<void>; leave(): Promise<void>; }

type GuestState = { phase: 'connecting'|'waiting_for_key'|'live'|'reconnecting'|'paused'|'ended'|'kicked'; me: {member: MemberId; slot: number; role: 'host'|'editor'|'viewer'; muted: boolean}; roster: RosterEntry[]; queue: {version: number; items: QueueItemView[]}; transcript: TranscriptEntry[]; agents: Record<AgentId, {state: string; owner: MemberId}>; lastSeq: number; warnings: ProtocolWarning[] }
reduceGuestState(state: GuestState, frame: DecodedFrame): GuestState (pure, total: never throws on unknown kind).
Error codes surfaced via CT-ERR typed errors: forbidden, queue_full, queue_item_gone, invalid_frame, client_too_old.
acceptance: Join against the simulator: sends sys.hello with last_seq null, reaches phase 'live' after sys.welcome and a roster frame in < 200 ms of simulated time.
submit() sends a queue frame with k `queue.submit`, frame id = a fresh que_ ULID, `p.size` equal to the byte length of the encrypted body, and resolves when the echo with seq arrives.
Replaying the same submit (same id) after a forced disconnect produces exactly one queue item in state.queue (relies on (sid, from, id) de-dup; the engine resends with the identical id).
Frames arriving out of order or duplicated by seq (fixture shuffle, 1 000 frames) yield a transcript identical to the in-order run; lastSeq equals the highest contiguous seq.
message.assistant.delta chunks sharing a message_id render in `index` order and finalise on message.assistant.done; a missing index stalls that message only and does not block other frames.

A viewer-role guest calling submit() rejects locally with typed error `forbidden` without sending a frame; the same frame sent by a hacked client is shown as a sys.error `forbidden` toast state, not a crash.
Sixth live item from one member is rejected locally with `queue_full` (per-member cap 5); a server `queue_full` for the session cap is surfaced identically.
A control.* frame whose `from` is not the server is ignored and recorded as a protocol warning; a frame with a bad `sig` or unknown `from` is dropped and recorded, never throws.

Before key.grant: 20 encrypted frames are buffered, phase is 'waiting_for_key'; after the grant all 20 decrypt in order within one reducer pass. Buffer cap 2 000 frames or 8 MiB, oldest evicted with a warning.
close code 4403 ends in phase 'kicked' with no reconnect; 4404 in 'ended'; 4401 triggers one token refresh then reconnect; 1001 reconnects within 250 ms + jitter.
tests: guest.reduce.fixtures.test.ts: runs every contracts/fixtures/events/*.json through reduceGuestState.
guest.reduce.property.test.ts (fast-check): any permutation/duplication of a frame set converges to the same state.
guest.queue.test.ts: submit, cancel, idempotent resend, caps, viewer/muted gating.
guest.join.integration.test.ts: loopback with the host engine (C075) and with the mock relay (C007), including forced disconnect and resume from hot buffer and from snapshot.
guest.fail.test.ts: bad sig, spoofed control frame, unknown kind, malformed envelope, 4403/4404/4401/4426 closes.
guardrails: MUST NOT treat the ticket `role` or any client-supplied role as authority; role comes from the latest control.roster / control.role frame and is used for UI gating only.
MUST ignore control.member_joined, member_left, roster, host_changed, session_state and rotate_key unless `from` is the server; spoofed control frames are the most dangerous input to a guest.
MUST verify `sig` over canonical JSON before decrypting content and drop on failure; MUST NOT log ct, decrypted payload, queue bodies or paths (only kind, seq, sizes).
MUST send ack at least every 5 s while inbound frames are unacked and after every 64 frames; MUST keep unacked outbound frames and resend with the same id.
MUST tolerate unknown kinds, unknown enum values and unknown agent states (render as 'working', log at debug); MUST NOT close the connection for them.
All buffers have documented caps (key-wait 2 000 frames/8 MiB; warnings ring 100; transcript in memory follows C036 virtualisation limit).
failure_modes: Transport drops mid-session -> phase 'reconnecting', fetch a new ticket per attempt, backoff 250 ms x 2^n full jitter cap 15 s, resume with last_seq; if sys.resumed says snapshot_required, load snapshot then history (CT-RESUME) and show 'earlier history unavailable' when none exists.
Snapshot fmt/v unknown -> refuse with a clear message, stay read-only on live frames, never apply partially.
Host leaves (control.session_state paused) -> composer disabled with calm banner, queue shown frozen, resumes on live.
Own submit never echoed within 10 s -> mark item 'unconfirmed', keep resending with same id until welcome/resume, then surface failure after 3 reconnects.
